_readme: Every cell names a cached artifact or is null. null renders as an em-dash
in RESULTS_MATRIX.md with a footnote -- make_results_matrix.py never
interpolates, infers, or back-fills a missing number.

g95_heldout.label: g95 held-out (no surface reference)
g95_heldout.note: Out-of-domain by text, not by lattice source: every sentence still comes from an SHR graphml. No surface segmentation gold exists outside the published 4,200, so S / P / R / F1 / PM are unmeasurable here by construction, not merely unmeasured.

_note: cands/kbest are here only to produce the recall@K curve out to 64.
Verified they do not perturb the top-1 ladder: with and without them
anchors. The reranker cell below is deliberately LEFT at kbest 32:
reranking over 64 candidates instead of 32 is a different experiment
and would move its 91.98, which is not what filling in a column means.

why: The CPU decoder is not a different system: same biaffine weights,
same lattice, same top-1 Viterbi. Week 10 established the GPU top-1
is digit-identical to it, and k4_bench_F_k64_checked.csv re-confirms
it here with score_mismatch = count_mismatch = 0 over all 119,503
sentences. So its accuracy row IS the cushr_gpu_top1 row; only
throughput differs. Stated here rather than copied silently, so a
reader can see it is an asserted identity, not a second measurement.
NOTE: cpu_bench.csv's own precision/recall/f1 are node-level over the
whole 119,503-sentence corpus and are NOT the surface-level numbers
measured on the 4,200. Do not put those in this table.
